data.title: Monica gave Lulu and Georgia 2 stars. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 2 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-2.svg)

Jul 27, 2023

## [Color totally off](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64c29aa6c4234462868d5a66)
It’s a well-made pillow, but the color is dramatically different than shown online. It’s very grey blue with no green undertones whatsoever in person. Since the job of a pillow really is to help tell the color story in a room, this was pretty disappointing.

July 16, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 28, 2023

Hello Monica, Thank you so much for your feedback and we’re so sorry to hear the color of the pillow that you ordered is not what you expected, we have shared this with the appropriate teams. We can see that you were able to initiate your return order through our Returns Portal and a refund will be processed soon, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
